mapper.sql: SELECT invited.id AS invitationId, invited.version, cycle.cycle_id AS cycleId, cycle.cycle_name AS cycleName, cycle.status AS cycleStatus, objective.objective_name AS objectiveName, employee.name AS evaluateeName, invited.evaluator_source AS evaluatorSource, invited.status, response.score, response.comment_text AS commentText, response.submit_time AS submitTime, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cycle.score_config, '$.minScore')) AS minScore, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cycle.score_config, '$.maxScore')) AS maxScore FROM hr_perf_evaluator invited JOIN hr_performance_objective objective ON objective.id = invited.objective_id AND objective.tenant_id = invited.tenant_id AND objective.deleted = 0 JOIN hr_appraisal_cycle cycle ON cycle.cycle_id = objective.cycle_id AND cycle.tenant_id = invited.tenant_id AND cycle.deleted = 0 JOIN hr_appraisal_result participant ON participant.cycle_id = cycle.cycle_id AND participant.tenant_id = cycle.tenant_id AND participant.employee_id = invited.evaluatee_id JOIN hr_employee employee ON employee.id = invited.evaluatee_id AND employee.tenant_id = invited.tenant_id AND employee.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN hr_perf_evaluator_response response ON response.evaluator_id = invited.id AND response.tenant_id = invited.tenant_id AND response.deleted = 0 AND invited.status = 'SUBMITTED' WHERE invited.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND invited.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} AND invited.deleted = 0 AND ((invited.evaluator_source = 'SELF' AND invited.evaluatee_id = invited.evaluator_id) OR (invited.evaluator_source IN ('MANAGER','PEER','SUBORDINATE') AND invited.evaluatee_id != invited.evaluator_id))
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS id, e.tenant_id AS tenantId, e.objective_id AS objectiveId, e.assignment_id AS assignmentId, e.result_id AS resultId, e.evaluatee_id AS evaluateeId, e.evaluatee_name AS evaluateeName, e.evaluator_id AS evaluatorId, evaluator_employee.user_id AS evaluatorUserId, e.evaluator_name AS evaluatorName, e.evaluator_source AS evaluatorSource, e.weight AS weight, e.status AS status, e.invite_time AS inviteTime, e.remind_count AS remindCount, o.objective_name AS objectiveName, o.cycle_name AS cycleName FROM hr_perf_evaluator e LEFT JOIN hr_employee evaluator_employee ON evaluator_employee.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND evaluator_employee.id = e.evaluator_id AND evaluator_employee.deleted = 0 AND e.evaluator_source != 'CUSTOMER' LEFT JOIN hr_performance_objective o ON o.id = e.objective_id AND o.tenant_id = e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.evaluator_id = #{evaluatorId} AND e.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY e.invite_time DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT e.evaluator_source AS evaluatorSource, e.weight AS weight, r.score AS score FROM hr_perf_evaluator e INNER JOIN hr_perf_evaluator_response r ON r.evaluator_id = e.id AND r.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.objective_id = #{objectiveId} AND e.evaluatee_id = #{evaluateeId} AND e.status = 'SUBMITTED'
